lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's twelve? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 12? Nope!

lines.text: A right triangle has corners at zero zero, p zero, and zero q.
lines.caption: A right triangle has corners at (0, 0), (p, 0), and (0, q).

lines.text: Exactly ten dots lie strictly inside. How many ordered pairs, p and q?
lines.caption: Exactly 10 dots lie strictly inside. How many ordered pairs, p and q?

lines.text: A twin triangle makes a square, with twenty-five dots inside.
lines.caption: A twin triangle makes a square, with 25 dots inside.

lines.text: Five sit on the slanted side. The other twenty split evenly: ten each!
lines.caption: Five sit on the slanted side. The other 20 split evenly: 10 each!

lines.text: Check every short leg this way: six pairs work.
lines.caption: Check every short leg this way: 6 pairs work.

lines.text: Flipping adds five more pairs. That's eleven!
lines.caption: Flipping adds 5 more pairs. That's 11!

lines.text: Twelve was the trap. Six and six flips into itself!
lines.caption: 12 was the trap. 6 and 6 flips into itself!

lines.text: Did you get eleven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 11? Tell me below!
